# Samsung AQV IR Signals (Remote ARH-466)

All codes captured via ESPHome IR Blaster (Tuya S11, CBU module, P8 receiver).
AC: AQV18NSCN (Living Room). Protocol shared across Samsung AQV family.
Format: Pronto hex (concatenated from multi-line ESPHome log output).

Carrier: 38 kHz (0x006D). ON commands use short header mark (~0x006F/2920µs).
OFF and fan_only use long header mark (~0x00BC/4944µs). See samsung_protocol.md for details.

## Fan Speed Naming

The remote display shows fan speed as bars. Original capture notes used
"Low/Mid/Mid-High/High" but the correct Samsung naming (per manual) is:

| Remote display | Correct name | Protocol fan bits (burst2 41-43) | Burst1 flag |
|---|---|---|---|
| No bars | Quiet | 000 | bit 45 = 1 |
| \| | Low | 010 | — |
| \|\| | Medium | 001 | — |
| \|\|\| | High | 101 | — |
| Animated | Auto | 000 | — |

## SmartIR Deployment

- **JSON file:** `9999.json` at `/config/custom_components/smartir/codes/climate/`
- **Generator:** `generate_samsung_ir.py` in home-network workspace
- **ESPHome config:** `ir-blaster.yaml` in home-network workspace
- **HA config:** `climate.yaml` with `!include` from `configuration.yaml`
- **Controller data:** `ir_blaster_send_raw_command` (ESPHome user-defined service)
- **Entity:** `climate.living_room_ac`
- **Fan modes:** auto, low, medium, medium_high, high (medium_high has no HA icon)
- **Swing modes:** off, on
- **Dry mode:** auto fan only
